title: Just a Small
description: This delicate and hypnotic film is created from an original six-panel, 4½ metre long watercolour painting. Split into 1,670 different frames, the images are woven into an ocean of calm. A story of a tiny eel becoming more than it’s origins, the animation ebbs and flows into the mystical.
directors: Na Kyung Kim Animation Na Kyung Kim
